title: Research: partitioned independent-walks 7q readout obstruction (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Answers the partitioned independent-walks open question on the [#2715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2715) / [#2761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2761) multi-connector lineage in the five-source common-B mutable-source alphabet of [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898): can two restored walks with distinct slot lists, independent dirt, and dual even-parity readout undercut tariff `436` at total `Q=7`?

| Dual schedule | Covering pairs | Exact R | Tariff floor (X≥0) | Undercuts 436? |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Same-walk even-subset (#2686) | — | ≥82 | ≥442 at X=6 | no |
| Partition `(2,5)` | **416640** | **112** | **≥490** | **no** |
| Partition `(3,4)` | **833280** | **112** | **≥490** | **no** |

Every covering partitioned dual has exact `R=112`. Length-1 components are not restored. Abstract tariff already `≥490 > 436` at `X=0`.

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2764](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2764) / [#2761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2761) / [#2715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2715) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/independent-walks-7q-obstruction/`.
Tip: `1f2a413f9e27ce9609924f7ab196548c4cbe43d8`.

Exact: partitioned dual min R **112** (tariff floor **490**); no undercut of 436.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-7q-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/independent-walks-7q-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-7q-obstruction/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-7q-obstruction/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/independent-walks-7q-obstruction
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_7Q_OBSTRUCTION partition_min_R=112 ... tariff_floor=490 ... answers_independent_walks_partitioned no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_PARTITIONED_WALKS_7Q covering_25=416640 covering_34=833280 ... tariff_floor=490 ... no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_7Q_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/independent-walks-7q-obstruction outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#2761](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2761) (same-walk multi-connector), [#2686](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2686), [#2715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2715). Freestanding partitioned dual-walk fixture; no competing open PR at refresh.
